solution_steps: Normal summon Tsukuyomi in attack mode and flip Spell Canceller face-down.
Activate Monster Reincarnation. By discarding United Resistance, return Bokoichi the Freightening Car to your hand.
Use Call of the Haunted to revive People Running About in attack mode.
Revive United Resistance with Premature Burial
Switch the Oppressed People to attack mode and attack directly.
